verdict.rationale: CloudConvert documents an AI task that carries out natural-language instructions on files (docs-19), but that is AI-driven file processing, not AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from the user's data. Nothing in the evidence shows the product analyzing data or surfacing recommendations, so the axis applies but is unsupported.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
